description: Header file defining the WebKitBrowser plugin class, related data structures, and interfaces for a web browser component within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, interface implementations, and JSON data structures for browser configuration.

classes.name: CookieJarParamsData
classes.description: JSON data container for browser cookie jar parameters, including version, checksum, and payload.

classes.name: WebKitBrowser
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing web browser functionalities, JSON RPC, and interface aggregation for the WebKit browser component.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Internal class handling various browser and connection notifications, forwarding events to the parent WebKitBrowser instance.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: JSON container for browser configuration data such as URL, FPS, visibility, and path.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with service context, sets up interfaces and configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters interfaces when plugin is unloaded.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Callback for when a page load finishes.

methods.name: LoadFailed
methods.description: Callback for when a page load fails.
